coverage_notes.method: Direct Aside browser survey only. Followed the visible homepage Publications link to Journals and the visible Journals section selector to discover Conferences. No OpenAlex, external bibliography databases, or inferred papers were used.
coverage_notes.filters: Both sections were traversed in default all-category state with empty search. Domestic and International were not restricted. No year tabs/controls were present; every pagination page was followed sequentially. AJAX pagination did not provide distinct page URLs, so page numbers are documented in the saved source text.
coverage_notes.preservation: Every listed record retained, in website order (Journals followed by Conferences). Repeated titles were not deduplicated. Full rendered titles and raw authors/venue/citation text were extracted from rendered cards rather than truncated accessibility labels. Conference years were extracted from their listed period text. No bibliographic correction or missing-paper inference was performed.
coverage_notes.doi_or_url_policy: doi_or_url contains the actual paper-detail URL linked by each listing. DOI enrichment was not performed; URLs are not claims that a DOI was present. Each citation_raw is the full visible listing-card text.
coverage_notes.excluded: Patents, which are linked as a separate publication section, are excluded because the requested array is research papers.
